packages.label: מֹחִין דְּגַדְלוּת וְהַמְתָּקָה
packages.reason: These two nodes share the same essential nature: the state of expanded, luminous consciousness (מֹחִין דְּגַדְלוּת) IS the sweetening (הַמְתָּקָה). When the great Tzaddik illuminates the small one and elevates him from smallness (מֹחִין דְּקַטְנוּת) to greatness (מֹחִין דְּגַדְלוּת), that very arrival at expanded consciousness is itself the sweetening — they are two names for the same transformative reality. The Rebbe uses the explicit formula 'שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת הַמְתָּקָה' to make the identity.
